title: Pandal
description: Schema for Kolkata Durga Puja pandals in the mobile application and Firestore database.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the pandal (e.g. 'hatibagan_sarbojanin').

source_id.description: Original source ID from pujoplanner.com if applicable.

name.description: Official or commonly known name of the Durga Puja pandal.

zone.description: Zone classification used for regional filtering.

theme.description: Artistic theme, style, or categorization (e.g. 'Traditional', 'Bonedi Bari', 'Theme-based Idol').

crowd_level.description: General or estimated crowd level for planning.

timings.description: Visiting hours / opening timings for visitors.

nearest_metro.description: Nearest metro station name and line (e.g. 'Shyambazar (Blue)').

nearest_railway.description: Nearest suburban or circular railway station (e.g. 'Kolkata Station (Circular)').

special_features.description: Notable accessibility features, laser shows, lighting, or attractions.

description.description: Historical context, highlights, or overview of the pandal.
